required_evidence: passwords persist only as salted hashes (IDN-5); plaintext passwords/PINs never persisted (IDN-6)
credential possession does not establish membership, role, or capability (IDN-4)
credential change revokes designated sessions via C12 revocation path (IDN-15)
Credential belongs to exactly one Identity via approved CredentialBelongsToIdentity (many-to-one)
protected reads/writes predicated by authoritative IdentityId
manager cannot choose, view, or retrieve employee credentials (IDN-13)
foreign modules cannot directly write Identity-owned Credential persistence
constraints: no shared or production migration execution
